questions.stem: Which of the following is the only metal that is exceptionally found strictly in a liquid state at normal room temperature?
questions.explanation: Mercury (Hg) is the only metal that is liquid at standard temperature and pressure. It was widely used in thermometers. Bromine is also a liquid at room temperature, but it is a non-metal.

questions.stem: Which chemical element is universally considered the absolute best conductor of electricity and heat among all known metals?
questions.explanation: Silver (Ag) has the highest electrical conductivity of any element. Copper is the second best and is much more commonly used in wiring because it is significantly cheaper than silver.

questions.stem: The physical property by which metals can be easily beaten or hammered into extremely thin sheets (like aluminum foil) without breaking is scientifically known as:
questions.explanation: Malleability is the ability to be hammered into sheets. Gold is the most malleable metal. Ductility, on the other hand, is the ability to be drawn into thin wires.
